versions.changelog:
- No code or documentation changes detected in this release.
- Version bump only; content and functionality remain unchanged.

Initial release of Kitchen Compass skill.

- Provides a portable, engine-only meal planning workspace, keeping logic distinct from household data.
- Includes clear setup, validation, and workflow guidance for managing recipes, inventory, meal planning, and meal history.
- Bundles reusable scripts for setup, recipe index building, querying, inventory management, weekly planning, deal tracking, and history recording.
- Ships with sample recipes and strict preservation of core contract/schema references.
- Supports dinner + side query and planning as the guaranteed v1 feature set.
